statements.status_notes: Memory allocation error handling bug in the glib-networking OpenSSL TLS backend. Debian trixie glib-networking 2.80.1-1 Build-Depends on libgnutls28-dev only and does not build the OpenSSL backend; upstream and the Debian security tracker note the OpenSSL backend is disabled by default. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-60019 and https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib-networking/-/issues/227.
